verses.text: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. For the music director. To the tune "The Suffering of Affliction." A thoughtful psalm of Heman the Ezrahite. LORD, the God who saves me, I cry out to you day and night.
Let my prayer come to you. Turn your ear to my cry.
My life is full of troubles. I am close to the grave.
I am counted among those going down to the pit. I am like a man with no strength left.
I have been left among the dead, like those killed in battle who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.
You have put me in the deepest pit, in the darkest depths.
Your anger lies heavy on me. You have crushed me with all your waves. Selah.
You have taken my friends away from me. You have made them disgusted with me. I am trapped and cannot escape.
My eyes are weak from sorrow. LORD, I call to you every day. I lift up my hands to you.
Do you do miracles for the dead? Do the dead get up and praise you? Selah.
Is your faithful love spoken of in the grave, or your faithfulness in the place of destruction?
Are your wonders known in the darkness, or your goodness in the land where people are forgotten?
But I cry to you for help, LORD. Every morning my prayer comes to you.
LORD, why do you reject me? Why do you hide your face from me?
I have suffered and been close to death since I was young. Your terrors have left me desperate.
Your burning anger has swept over me. Your terrors have destroyed me.
They surround me like a flood all day long. They have closed in on me completely.
You have taken my loved ones and friends away from me. Darkness is my closest friend.
